_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for player/coach pronunciation and preferred announced names across NZIHL/NZWIHL broadcast graphics. Keyed by esportsdesk playerID (players) or the same synthetic league:TLA:coach:First|Last|Title scheme the photo-warehouse manifest uses (coaches, who have no playerID). 'source' is manual-mat / manual-michael (hand-reviewed via the ops review page, attributed to whoever actually did the review), manual-claude (Claude's hand-verified pass at build time), or auto-engine (rule-based baseline -- see confidence/note). Mat reviews every entry via the offline review page and flips 'reviewed' to true; this file is regenerated by re-running build_pronunciations.py against fresh stats.json, so any of Mat's review-page edits must be merged back in (the review page exports a patch, not a fresh copy) rather than lost on the next regen.
